name: cowrie-ai
description: Zero-dependency MCP virtualization & taint proxy (`npx cowrie-ai mcp-proxy --virtualize`), CLI, and WebAssembly SDK for Cowrie v1.2.

scripts.build:wasm: node -e 'import("node:child_process").then(cp => { const target = process.env.CARGO_TARGET_DIR || "/tmp/cowrie-cargo-target"; cp.execFileSync("cargo", ["build", "-p", "cowrie-core", "--target", "wasm32-unknown-unknown", "--release"], { cwd: "..", stdio: "inherit", env: { ...process.env, CARGO_TARGET_DIR: target, RUSTFLAGS: "-C strip=symbols" } }); import("node:fs").then(fs => fs.copyFileSync(target + "/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/cowrie_core.wasm", "./cowrie_core.wasm")); })'
